description.value: The Clubhouse is one of several distinct rooms within the Strathcona Hotel's Sticky Wicket complex — Vancouver Island's largest pub — occupying a prime spot on Douglas Street in downtown Victoria. It functions as a bright, spacious dining room during the day and transforms into a lively bar in the evening. Touring cyclists stopping in Victoria will find it part of a sprawling venue that also includes a rooftop patio, a sports games room, and a live-music stage.
